name: Touhou Yuugetsutan ~Over the Moon River.~
original_name: 東方悠月譚 ～Over the Moon River.～
source:
Featuring Ud*nge in a lesbian story centered in Eientei town.

After she drinks a magical potion and becomes tiny,
Ud*nge gets teased by her teacher, mistress and T*wi. 

[from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE066658.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
以永远亭小镇为舞台，辉夜的百合故事。辉夜喝下魔药变小后，被老师、女主人和帝捉弄。

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE066658.html]DLsite English[/url]]
